root.label: UNIFIL reports IDF violations since June 2026

events.label: UNIFIL reports IDF violations since June 2026

slots.name: reported violations
slots.sentence: With the help of that outpost, UNIFIL has recorded more than 11,000 violations by the IDF since June this year, including airspace violations, airstrikes, artillery strikes, as well as the IDF's illegal presence in Lebanon.

slots.name: Hezbollah violations
slots.sentence: One violation has been attributed to Hezbollah.

slots.name: cease-fire date
slots.sentence: There has been little active fighting following a June cease-fire, but the Israeli military has continued to demolish civilian infrastructure as part of its stated plan to create a depopulated buffer zone on Lebanese soil to keep Hezbollah away from its northern border.
